name: Cherry Tomato
hook: Yes, you can grow tomatoes on a tiny balcony.

steps.title: Full sun is a must
steps.tip: Pick your sunniest balcony spot; fewer than 6 hours of sun means few flowers or fruit.

steps.title: Go big on the pot
steps.tip: Use a container of at least 20 L with drainage holes; small pots dry out too fast.

steps.title: Water deeply, daily
steps.tip: Water at the base each morning in summer; uneven watering causes split fruit.

steps.title: Feed once fruit swells
steps.tip: Once the first fruits swell, give a high-potassium tomato feed every 10–14 days.

steps.title: Stake and pinch side shoots
steps.tip: Tall (cordon) types: tie to a stake, pinch side shoots in leaf joints. Bush types: leave them.

steps.title: Check for aphids
steps.tip: Blast aphids off with a strong water spray, or use insecticidal soap on leaf undersides.

outro: Sun, a big pot and steady water = handfuls of sweet tomatoes.

sources.title: UMN Extension: Aphids in home yards and gardens
